milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cobblestone enclosure center is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5). The player must walk toward it and face it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=8 requires the player to actually approach (not just look from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they're looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining a damaged anvil with a pickaxe drops the damaged_anvil item into the player's inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe to mine it. The anvil is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5) inside the cobblestone enclosure. This is the most direct check for a mining task — the mined item appears in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond axe places it directly in the player's inventory. The player has 3 diamonds and 2 sticks, and a crafting table is at spawn-relative (-3, 0, 0). The recipe is 3 diamonds + 2 sticks. This is the standard check for craft tasks — the crafted item ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining bamboo drops bamboo items into the player's inventory. Bamboo plants are placed at spawn-relative positions around (9-12, 1, -3 to -4) on podzol. When broken (by hand or with any tool), bamboo drops as an inventory item. Checking for at least 1 bamboo in inventory confirms the mining task is complete.
